translations.web: “ ‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
translations.bsb: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
translations.kjv: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
translations.asv: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
